context: M10 o2. W 28th St at 04:50. Moretti hoses palms on the sidewalk. Her truck sits on two flat tyres.

lines.speaker: char.anna_moretti
lines.text: Five a.m. I've got gladiolus, roses and a cop who wants twenty. One of those wilts.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I'm not a cop, Mrs. Moretti. I'm the guy they send instead.

lines.speaker: char.anna_moretti
lines.text: My father paid nobody in 1931. I'm not paying in 1974.

lines.speaker: char.anna_moretti
lines.text: And look at my truck. Two tyres, slashed. Third time since June. Who does that?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Twenty, Mrs. Moretti. Or next week they send somebody who isn't polite.

lines.speaker: char.anna_moretti
lines.text: Take it. Choke on it. Mind the fronds on your way out.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I'll tell them you weren't open yet. Get your tyres fixed.

lines.speaker: char.anna_moretti
lines.text: …Huh. You want to help? Grab a palm. Mind the fronds.

lines.speaker: char.anna_moretti
lines.text: Ask the Carriers' boys about my tyres. Ask the one with the radio voice.
